title: 伊莉丝·亮彩手绘 Sketch
description: 深红头发衬着尖形冠饰，背后分节的蛛形附肢保持独立轮廓。

art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Elise is an adult pale-skinned woman with dark red hair, ruby eyes, a pointed ornamental crown, and articulated spider appendages extending from her back. Preserve the distinctive arachnid silhouette and red-black palette while dressing her in a fully opaque high-collared long-sleeved gown with covered legs. Her face is composed, and the rear limbs remain folded with no fangs, wounds, or frightening spider swarm.
art_direction.scene: A low three-quarter full-figure study, grounded relaxed stance, clear triangular silhouette and one bright diagonal of sunlight. Build the composition around this champion's defining anatomy and core motif. Only a few light environment marks; keep the picture predominantly bright and colorful.
art_direction.palette: oxblood red, plum, black-violet, pale stone light; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: Compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280 and under 350 KB
